title: Proving the evidence pack sent is the one signed
story: A disputed INR 1,250 payment's Evidence pack is signed off by a reviewer. Later someone asks whether the pack sent to the bank is the one the reviewer approved. Verify-pack rebuilds the evidence from the Audit chain, checks the pack's hash against the Sign-off, and walks the chain.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is scheduled. I'll let you know once the money is taken.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: I don't remember agreeing to this FreshMart charge. I've told my bank I never authorised it.

what_to_notice: The Sign-off recorded the pack's hash in the Audit chain. Verify-pack hashes the stored pack again and compares, rebuilds its bundle from the chain, and checks every claim cites a record in it. Nobody can swap the evidence after approval without it showing.
